items.question: Does all-knowingness arise by knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: knowing the hidden true nature precedes arising
all-knowingness is the result of that knowing
the hidden true nature is the object known
items.inference: All-knowingness arises through knowledge of the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: the exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context
compound internal sandhi is preserved as given
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
